args.title: Fix report preview showing early transactions instead of recent ones
args.body:
src/api/reports.ts

The report preview endpoint in `src/api/reports.ts` loads report previews with `transactionRepo.listForReport(report, { limit: PREVIEW_ROWS })`, but it does not specify a sort order or offset/pagination parameters, causing the preview to return the first transactions inserted or ordered arbitrarily rather than the most recent ones for the report date range. This fix updates the preview query to fetch the transactions correctly ordered by date.
